issues: Reuse of the organisers' sample (BRIEF: never reuse its numbers): the figures and evidence pattern mirror case-00901 - cancellation_fee_sgd 5.00 and free_wait_sec 300 (both identical to the sample's platform_policy), arrival_marker GPS_AUTO with a sparse DRIVER_DEVICE export whose fixes carry no accuracy, the identical code pair LOW_SAMPLE_RATE + PARTIAL_RECORD giving the sample's exact weight 0.6, an empty rider_track, and a single unanswered driver in-app call. The NS-12 mechanism is legitimately needed, but the numbers should not echo the sample.

POL-NS-08(a) edge that can flip the ruling: the export's last fix (13:15:50) is 100 s after the trip_record termination (13:14:10), and its first fix (12:59:40) is exactly 90 s after accepted_at (12:58:10). A reader who compares the export's span with the trip_record times can say the two 'disagree on trip termination time by more than 90 seconds'. NS-08(a) does not say which artifact is then impaired; if the trip_record (the NS-12 carrier) is read as impaired, the platform events are no longer an unimpaired independent carrier, the impaired export is the only evidence, and NS-08's closing sentence / NS-09(e) escalate - a second defensible outcome. The design note moved the last fix away from a 90 s edge but landed on 100 s on the other side.
fixes: Move the post-termination export fix to about 13:14:50 (40 s after the 13:14:10 termination; on the departure leg, about 250-300 m from the pin at about 28 km/h) so last_fix_at is well within 90 s of the termination; the 13:12:40 -> 13:14:50 interval (130 s) keeps NS-08(b) engaged on the export as designed, and the fix stays outside the waiting window so it cannot contradict the platform events. Move the first export fix to about 12:58:45 (35 s after acceptance) and re-place it on the approach route. Recompute trace_distance_km, gaps and the GPS notes.

De-echo the sample while keeping the NS-12 test: e.g. platform_policy cancellation_fee_sgd 6.00 with rider_gross_cancellation_fee_sgd 8.81, free_wait_sec 240, no_show_threshold_sec 360; wait_timer_started 13:06:05, wait_timer_expired 13:10:05, no_show_threshold_reached 13:12:00, termination unchanged at 13:14:10 (490 s >= 360). Fare line and refund become 8.81 (gross), amount_contested_sgd 6.00 (net), payout 0.80 x 6.00 = 4.80 (ruling and difficulty unchanged; any non-sample net fee works, payout = 0.80 x net, a multiple of 0.05).

Optionally also change the export's code pair so its weight is not the sample's 0.6: give rider_track a few accuracy-filtered rider fixes (> 25 m) so PARTIAL_RECORD drops and the export is LOW_SAMPLE_RATE only (0.8). NS-12 is still required, because NS-02 cannot run on accuracy-less fixes and NS-08(b) still fires on the export (3 fixes, gaps > 120 s). Update the event detail, claim_text and notes for the new figures.

issues: Second defensible outcome via POL-NS-06's own text: 'a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, and asserting it against a MISSING artifact triggers POL-NS-09 rather than exonerating anyone.' The driver's counterparty_statement ('buses and cars behind me were honking, I could not hold my position there for long') and MSG-04065-006 ('bay very crowded cannot wait long') assert precisely limb (i)'s predicate - that holding position was not possible - while EV-ADVIS-04065-01 is MISSING. A careful reader can treat that as limb (i) asserted against a missing advisory and escalate under NS-09, instead of the planned FULL_REFUND, on a case labelled EASY. (The better reading is that limb (i) only sums separate in-geofence intervals and the driver never left the radius, but the case should not depend on winning that argument; NS has no counterpart of POL-RD-13 to settle it.)
fixes: Recommended: reword the driver's excuse as impatience, not an external kerb condition. counterparty_statement e.g. 'She said walking over 5 min, when I reached she still say 2 more min. Peak hour I cannot keep waiting for one passenger, so I cancelled.' MSG-04065-006 e.g. 'still 2 min ah? I cannot wait so long leh'. The trap (upholding the fee because the driver felt he had waited enough) is kept; nothing else changes (dwell 95 s vs 300 s, FULL_REFUND 8.00).

Alternative if the crowding story is wanted: make EV-ADVIS-04065-01 present with a non-qualifying type (e.g. CONGESTION on the interchange access road, covering the window), so nothing is asserted against a MISSING artifact; limb (i) then fails on type and on the absence of separate intervals, and NS-06(ii) keeps the refund.
